recipe.visualDefinition: A full-length portrait of a man in outdoor attire standing on a rocky outcrop in the center of a rushing river, framed by a steep evergreen-covered bank and a small waterfall. The image features a desaturated, slightly grainy 1970s film quality with high-contrast whites in the water foam.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against the horizontal rush of the river
Verticality of the trees and rocky bank contrasting with the horizontal water flow
Man's dark plaid jacket providing a focal point against the bright white water
coreInvariants: Analog film grain and soft focus in the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, full-body figure, occupying approximately one-third of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man standing on the dark rock in the lower-middle foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject, follows the water flow left to right, then moves upward to the forest and the top-aligned text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space provided by the water and the sky/forest canopy at the top.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted forest green and slate grey (background/river rocks)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep red (undershirt) and dark green plaid
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark rocks and white water.

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the upper forest canopy area for contrast

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight contrast within the same typeface family (Medium for title, Bold for name).
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment along the top margin

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 1970s aesthetic and clean strokes.
Period-accurate geometric sans with tight kerning capabilities.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s film-style photograph of a man in a green plaid jacket standing on a rock in the middle of a rushing river with a small waterfall. The background should be a steep, rocky bank with evergreen trees. Use a desaturated color palette with high-contrast white water.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of all-caps geometric sans-serif text at the top center. Use a medium weight for the first half and a bold weight for the second half. Set the text in white with tight tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the text all-caps and geometric?
Is the water foam bright white against muted surroundings?
Does the image have a visible film grain texture?

mustRedesign: Do not use contemporary outdoor gear styles
Ensure the text is not obscured by the background

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between man and nature
avoid: Modern sans-serifs like Helvetica or Arial

postGenerationChecks: Verify the subject is standing on a rock, not floating.
Check that the white water doesn't blow out all detail.
Ensure the text weight transition is visible.
Confirm the aspect ratio is square.
recipe.reuseFormula: Analog wilderness portrait + centered subject + top-aligned geometric sans-serif typography.
